transactions.desc: The Rangers designated Curvelo for assignment Friday.
The Rangers selected Gonzales' contract from Triple-A Round Rock on Friday.
The Rangers optioned Peoples to Triple-A Round Rock on Friday.
The Rangers optioned Cauley to Triple-A Round Rock on Friday.
The Rangers recalled Freeman from Triple-A Round Rock on Friday.
The Brewers recalled Anderson from Triple-A Nashville on Friday.
Richardson signed a minor-league contract with the Brewers on Friday, Curt Hogg of the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel reports.
Leonard was outrighted to Triple-A Sacramento on Friday after clearing waivers, Susan Slusser of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
The Mariners selected Rodden's contract from Triple-A Tacoma on Friday, Adam Jude of The Seattle Times reports.
The Yankees signed Topa to a minor-league contract Friday, Gary Phillips of the New York Daily News reports.
The Blue Jays optioned Estrada to Triple-A Buffalo on Friday.
Hill (oblique) was activated from the 7-day injured list at Double-A Akron on Friday.
Lively (elbow) was activated from the 60-day injured list at Triple-A Columbus on Friday.
The White Sox designated Rock for assignment Friday.
The Pirates recalled Dotel from Triple-A Indianapolis on Friday.
The Pirates recalled Cook from Triple-A Indianapolis on Friday.
The Pirates optioned Garcia to Triple-A Indianapolis on Friday.
The Giants optioned Furman to Triple-A Sacramento on Friday, Susan Slusser of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
The White Sox claimed Rogers off waivers from the Red Sox on Friday, Chris Cotillo of MassLive.com reports.
The Giants optioned McCray to Triple-A Sacramento on Friday, Susan Slusser of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
The Giants recalled Cox from Triple-A Sacramento on Friday, Susan Slusser of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
The Orioles optioned Hiraldo to Triple-A Norfolk on Friday.
The Orioles activated Bassitt (back) from the 60-day injured list Friday.
The White Sox recalled Schweitzer from Triple-A Charlotte on Friday.
The White Sox optioned McDougal to Triple-A Charlotte on Friday.
The White Sox recalled Urquidy from Triple-A Charlotte on Friday.
The Giants selected Hill's contract from Triple-A Sacramento on Thursday.
The Twins designated Jackson for assignment Thursday, Dan Hayes of The Athletic reports.
Knack was optioned to Triple-A Oklahoma City on Thursday, Bill Plunkett of The Orange County Register reports.
Hernandez had his contract selected by the Dodgers on Thursday, Bill Plunkett of The Orange County Register reports.
